gadgets.payload: {"__proto__": {"<option>": "<value>"}}  sent as JSON to any handler that merges the request body
gadgets.effect: mergeDeep walks Object.keys(source); a JSON-parsed body carries __proto__ as an OWN enumerable key, so it is enumerated. `if (!target[key])` sees the inherited Object.prototype (truthy) and skips the guard, then recurses into mergeDeep(Object.prototype, payload) and Object.assign()s every leaf onto Object.prototype. No __proto__/constructor filtering at all.
gadgets.precondition: the merged source is JSON.parse()d (express.json / body-parser preserves the own __proto__ key; object rest/spread preserves it too)
gadgets.trap: the merge adds NO own key to the target, so the caller's subsequent ORM .update() is a no-op on the row and may still answer 500 from an unrelated failure. A 500 does not mean the pollution failed — verify it out of band, e.g. pollute `cookies` and watch cookie-parser return early (it skips when req.cookies is truthy, and req.cookies resolves through the prototype).
